details:
So a friend and I sleep in vr and it seems ever since the IK update when I'm in half body and my quest 2 controllers disconnect instead of putting my hands in to the pc animation they fly to a random spot instead based off of where steamvr thinks the controllers are. The dark picture is with the steamvr menu open after disconnect and shows where steamvr thinks my controller is causing my hand to fly that way.
My friend on the other hand has a valve index and his hands go to desktop mode when he turns them off as expected. The issue for him however has been when in half body he eventually snaps to a random spot on the same plane we were laying on. He isn't losing tracking as he has 4 base stations, its on the same exact plane not like he flew to a base station and has never been a problem before. It happens at random times for him, sometimes it could be very shortly after he falls asleep or hours. 
I notice as well when going in to the steamvr menu hands no longer go in to pc animation in half body and they don't stick out bent at the elbow when in full body. Seems to be a bug since we are both using different devices experiencing semi-similar issues with tracking loss primarily when in half body and didn't happen until after the ik update.
title: Tracking loss since the IK 2.0 Update.
